## SOM Stats

### Compare years

```{r SOM years only}

#match data
SOM_multiyr_match <- SOM_multiyr[,c(1:16)] %>%
  filter(Site_ID != "AU" & Site_ID != "FU") %>%
  mutate(Site_ID = droplevels(Site_ID)) %>% #drop unused factor levels
  mutate(Sample_yr_ch = paste0("_", Sample_year)) #force to character variable (as.factor and as.character weren't working)

#define what to analyze
factors <- "Sample_yr_ch" #predictor variable
continuous_vars <- c("pH", "SOM_perC", "SOM_C_kgm2_7cm", "SOM_perN", "SOM_CN",
                     "POM_perC", "POM_C_kgm2_7cm", "POM_perN",
                     "MAOM_perC", "MAOM_C_kgm2_7cm", "MAOM_perN", "fMAOM_C") #response variables
data <- SOM_multiyr_match

#evaluate group sizes
evaluate_group_sizes(data, factors, continuous_vars) 
summarize_group_sizes(data, factors, continuous_vars) 

#run the analysis
SOMyr_diff <- differences(data, factors, continuous_vars)

#filter only significant
SOMyr_sigdiff <- SOMyr_diff %>%
  filter(P_Value <= 0.05)



```

```{r SOM years sites}

#test for year and site
factors <- c("Site_ID", "Sample_yr_ch")
continuous_vars <- c("pH", "SOM_perC", "SOM_C_kgm2_7cm", "SOM_perN", "SOM_CN",
                     "POM_perC", "POM_C_kgm2_7cm", "POM_perN",
                     "MAOM_perC", "MAOM_C_kgm2_7cm", "MAOM_perN", "fMAOM_C") #response variables
data <- SOM_multiyr_match

SOMyrsite_diff <- differences_multifactor(data, factors, continuous_vars)

#test one set to make sure same results
#diagnostics
shapiro.test(resid(lm(SOM_perC ~ Sample_year * Site_ID, data = SOM_multiyr_match))) #almost normal
leveneTest(lm(SOM_perC ~ Sample_yr_ch * Site_ID, data = SOM_multiyr_match)) #heterogenous

#non-parametric
anova(art(SOM_perC ~ factor(Sample_yr_ch) * Site_ID, data = SOM_multiyr_match)) #ART ANOVA
scheirerRayHare(SOM_perC ~ factor(Sample_yr_ch) * Site_ID, data = SOM_multiyr_match) #SRH alternative to ART
dunn.test(SOM_multiyr_match$SOM_perC, c(factor(SOM_multiyr_match$Sample_yr_ch), SOM_multiyr_match$Site_ID), method="bonferroni", kw=TRUE)

#compare parametric - same outcomes
summary(aov(SOM_perC ~ Sample_year * Site_ID, data = SOM_multiyr_match)) 
TukeyHSD(aov(SOM_perC ~ factor(Sample_year) + Site_ID, data = SOM_multiyr_match)) 

#combine Site ID and year
SOM_multiyr_match <- SOM_multiyr_match %>%
  mutate(Site_yr = paste0(Site_ID, Sample_yr_ch)) #put together

#test for year and site
factors <- c("Site_yr")
continuous_vars <- c("pH", "SOM_perC", "SOM_C_kgm2_7cm", "SOM_perN", "SOM_CN",
                     "POM_perC", "POM_C_kgm2_7cm", "POM_perN",
                     "MAOM_perC", "MAOM_C_kgm2_7cm", "MAOM_perN", "fMAOM_C") #response variables
data <- SOM_multiyr_match

SOMyrsite_diff2 <- differences(data, factors, continuous_vars)

#filter only significant
SOMyrsite_sigdiff <- SOMyrsite_diff2 %>%
  filter(P_Value <= 0.05)

#calculate means to compare differences between years
SOM_multiyr_diff <- SOM_multiyr_match %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample_year, Site_ID, SOM_perC, POM_perC, MAOM_perC, SOM_C_kgm2_7cm, POM_C_kgm2_7cm, MAOM_C_kgm2_7cm) %>%
  group_by(Sample_year, Site_ID) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), list(mean = ~mean(., na.rm=TRUE)))) #run all summary stats

#Calculate differences between years for each site and fraction
SOM_multiyr_diff <- SOM_multiyr_diff %>%
  group_by(Sample_year, Site_ID) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(SOM_perC_mean, POM_perC_mean, MAOM_perC_mean, SOM_C_kgm2_7cm_mean, POM_C_kgm2_7cm_mean, MAOM_C_kgm2_7cm_mean), names_to = "Fraction", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample_year, values_from = Value) %>%
  mutate(Diff = `2026` - `2023`) 


```


### Log response ratios cutting
```{r calculate LRRs}

#unmanaged only means
avg_unmg_SOM <- SOM_2026 %>%
  filter(Management == "Unmanaged") %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean)) #get mean


#create log response ratios
LRR_SOM <- SOM_2026[c(3:5,31:63)] %>%
  dplyr::filter(Management == "Hay cutting") %>%
  #for SOM C
  mutate(SOM_perC_unmg = #add column for unmanaged means
           case_when(Site == "Bickershaw"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$SOM_perC[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Bickershaw"],
                     Site == "Amberswood"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$SOM_perC[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Amberswood"],
                     Site == "Flashes" 
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$SOM_perC[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Flashes"])) %>%
  mutate(LRR_SOM_perC = log(SOM_perC/SOM_perC_unmg)) %>% #calculate log response ratio percent C
  mutate(SOM_CTha_unmg = #add column for unmanaged means
           case_when(Site == "Bickershaw"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$SOM_C_Tha[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Bickershaw"],
                     Site == "Amberswood"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$SOM_C_Tha[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Amberswood"],
                     Site == "Flashes" 
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$SOM_C_Tha[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Flashes"])) %>%
  mutate(LRR_SOM_CTha = log(SOM_C_Tha/SOM_CTha_unmg)) %>% #calculate log response ratio
  mutate(SOM_newC_unmg = #add column for unmanaged means
           case_when(Site == "Bickershaw"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$new_C[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Bickershaw"],
                     Site == "Amberswood"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$new_C[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Amberswood"],
                     Site == "Flashes" 
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$new_C[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Flashes"])) %>%
  mutate(LRR_SOM_newC = log(new_C/SOM_newC_unmg)) %>% #calculate log response ratio percent C
  
  #for SOM N
  mutate(SOM_perN_unmg = #add column for unmanaged means
           case_when(Site == "Bickershaw"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$SOM_perN[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Bickershaw"],
                     Site == "Amberswood"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$SOM_perN[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Amberswood"],
                     Site == "Flashes" 
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$SOM_perN[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Flashes"])) %>%
  mutate(LRR_SOM_perN = log(SOM_perN/SOM_perN_unmg)) %>%
  
  #for POM C
  mutate(POM_perC_unmg = #add column for unmanaged means
           case_when(Site == "Bickershaw"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$POM_perC[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Bickershaw"],
                     Site == "Amberswood"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$POM_perC[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Amberswood"],
                     Site == "Flashes" 
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$POM_perC[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Flashes"])) %>%
  mutate(LRR_POM_perC = log(POM_perC/POM_perC_unmg)) %>% 
  mutate(POM_C_kgm2_unmg = #add column for unmanaged means
           case_when(Site == "Bickershaw"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$POM_C_kgm2_7cm[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Bickershaw"],
                     Site == "Amberswood"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$POM_C_kgm2_7cm[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Amberswood"],
                     Site == "Flashes" 
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$POM_C_kgm2_7cm[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Flashes"])) %>%
  mutate(LRR_POM_C_kgm2 = log(POM_C_kgm2_7cm/POM_C_kgm2_unmg)) %>%
  
  #for POM N
  mutate(POM_perN_unmg = #add column for unmanaged means
           case_when(Site == "Bickershaw"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$POM_perN[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Bickershaw"],
                     Site == "Amberswood"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$POM_perN[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Amberswood"],
                     Site == "Flashes" 
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$POM_perN[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Flashes"])) %>%
  mutate(LRR_POM_perN = log(POM_perN/POM_perN_unmg)) %>% 
  
  #for MAOM C
  mutate(MAOM_perC_unmg = #add column for unmanaged means
           case_when(Site == "Bickershaw"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$MAOM_perC[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Bickershaw"],
                     Site == "Amberswood"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$MAOM_perC[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Amberswood"],
                     Site == "Flashes" 
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$MAOM_perC[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Flashes"])) %>%
  mutate(LRR_MAOM_perC = log(MAOM_perC/MAOM_perC_unmg)) %>% 
  mutate(MAOM_C_kgm2_unmg = #add column for unmanaged means
           case_when(Site == "Bickershaw"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$MAOM_C_kgm2_7cm[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Bickershaw"],
                     Site == "Amberswood"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$MAOM_C_kgm2_7cm[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Amberswood"],
                     Site == "Flashes" 
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$MAOM_C_kgm2_7cm[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Flashes"])) %>%
  mutate(LRR_MAOM_C_kgm2 = log(MAOM_C_kgm2_7cm/MAOM_C_kgm2_unmg)) %>%
  
  #for MAOM N
  mutate(MAOM_perN_unmg = #add column for unmanaged means
           case_when(Site == "Bickershaw"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$MAOM_perN[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Bickershaw"],
                     Site == "Amberswood"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$MAOM_perN[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Amberswood"],
                     Site == "Flashes" 
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$MAOM_perN[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Flashes"])) %>%
  mutate(LRR_MAOM_perN = log(MAOM_perN/MAOM_perN_unmg)) %>%
  
  #fMAOM-C
  mutate(fMAOM_C_unmg = #add column for unmanaged means
           case_when(Site == "Bickershaw"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$fMAOM_C[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Bickershaw"],
                     Site == "Amberswood"
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$fMAOM_C[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Amberswood"],
                     Site == "Flashes" 
                     ~ avg_unmg_SOM$fMAOM_C[avg_unmg_SOM$Site == "Flashes"])) %>%
  mutate(LRR_fMAOM_C = log(fMAOM_C/fMAOM_C_unmg))
```

### Compare with UK-wide unimproved grasslands soil C
```{r SOC compare}

#define what to analyze - do restored vs unimproved first
factors <- "type" #predictor variable
continuous_vars <- c("TotalC", "POM_C", "MAOM_C", "TotalC2") #response variables
data <- soilC_compare

#run the analysis
UK_type_diff <- differences(data, factors, continuous_vars)

#Total C check
#diagnostics
shapiro.test(resid(lm(TotalC ~ type, data = soilC_compare))) #check normality of residuals - not normal but high W
leveneTest(lm(TotalC ~ type, data = soilC_compare)) #homogenous
#parametric
summary(aov(TotalC ~ type, data = soilC_compare)) #sig
TukeyHSD(aov(TotalC ~ type, data = soilC_compare)) #rest higher
#non-parametric
kruskal.test(TotalC ~ type, data = soilC_compare) #sig
dunn.test(soilC_compare$TotalC, soilC_compare$type, method="bonferroni", kw=TRUE) #rest higher

#define what to analyze - vegetation (compare grassland types and sites)
factors <- "vegetation" #predictor variable
continuous_vars <- c("TotalC", "POM_C", "MAOM_C", "TotalC2") #response variables
data <- soilC_compare

#run the analysis
UK_veg_diff <- differences(data, factors, continuous_vars)

#filter only significant
UK_veg_sigdiff <- UK_veg_diff %>%
  filter(P_Value <= 0.05)
  
```

### Linear Mixed Models explaining soil C

#### By soil pH

```{r SOC pH}

#SOM C
shapiro.test(resid(lmer(SOM_C ~ pH + (1|Site_ID), #site random
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit))) #check normality of residuals - not normal but high W
leveneTest(lm(SOM_C ~ pH_range, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #homogeneous

#art
summary(art(SOM_C ~ factor(pH_range) + (1|Site_ID), #aligned rank transform - check
            data = SOM_13C_T0))
anova(art(SOM_C ~ factor(pH_range) + (1|Site_ID), #aligned rank transform anova
            data = SOM_13C_T0)) #not sig

Anova(lmer(SOM_C ~ pH_range + (1|Site_ID), #site random
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit), type=3) #not sig

#POM C
shapiro.test(resid(lmer(POM_C ~ pH + (1|Site_ID), #site random
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit))) #check normality of residuals - normal
leveneTest(lm(POM_C ~ pH_range, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #homogeneous

Anova(lmer(POM_C ~ pH + (1|Site_ID), #site random
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit), type=3) #not sig

shapiro.test(resid(lmer(MAOM_C ~ pH + (1|Site_ID), #site random
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit))) #check normality of residuals - normal
leveneTest(lm(MAOM_C ~ pH_range, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #heterogeneous

#with site random
summary(art(MAOM_C ~ factor(pH_range) + (1|Site_ID), #aligned rank transform - check
            data = SOM_13C_T0))
anova(art(MAOM_C ~ factor(pH_range) + (1|Site_ID), #aligned rank transform anova
            data = SOM_13C_T0)) #not sig

Anova(lmer(MAOM_C ~ pH + (1|Site_ID), #site random
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit), type=3) #sig

MAOM_C_pH_lme <- lmer(MAOM_C ~ pH + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit)
summary(MAOM_C_pH_lme) #random accounts for less
performance::r2(MAOM_C_pH_lme, multivariate=TRUE) #calculate R-squared for model fit
MuMIn::AICc(MAOM_C_pH_lme, k=2) #calculate AICc for for model comparison with small sample sizes
```

## AM Association 

### By site

```{r AM assoc site}

#define what to analyze
factors <- "Site_ID" #predictor variable
continuous_vars <- c("AM_hyph_per", "AM_hyph_ct", "AM_arb_per", "AM_arb_ct",
                     "AM_ves_ct", "AM_absent") #response variables
data <- SOM_13C_T0

#evaluate group sizes
#evaluate_group_sizes(data, factors, continuous_vars) 
summarize_group_sizes(data, factors, continuous_vars) 

#run the analysis
AM_siteid_diff <- differences(data, factors, continuous_vars)

#filter only significant
AM_siteid_sigdiff <- AM_siteid_diff %>%
  filter(P_Value <= 0.05)

```

### By multiple vars
```{r AM vs multi}

#hyphae
summary(aov(AM_hyph_per ~ SOM_N, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #very
cor.test(SOM_13C_T0$AM_hyph_per, SOM_13C_T0$SOM_N, method = "pearson") #0.46, P=0.003


#together
AMhyph_lme <- lmer(AM_hyph_per ~ SOM_15N + SOM_N + pH + g_debris + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit)
summary(AMhyph_lme) #random accounts for less variance
Anova(AMhyph_lme) #15N only significant
shapiro.test(resid(AMhyph_lme)) #normal
check_collinearity(AMhyph_lme) #check VIFs for collinearity in model
performance::model_performance(AMhyph_lme) #AICc 19.2, R2 0.404



#arbuscules
AMarb_lme <- lmer(AM_arb_per ~ SOM_15N + pH + g_debris + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit)
summary(AMarb_lme) #random accounts for less variance
Anova(AMarb_lme) #15N only significant
shapiro.test(resid(AMarb_lme)) #not normal but close
check_collinearity(AMarb_lme) #check VIFs for collinearity in model
performance::model_performance(AMarb_lme) #



```

#### pH lme

```{r AM pH lme}

#hyph percent
shapiro.test(resid(lmer(AM_hyph_per ~ pH + (1|Site_ID), #site random
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit))) #check normality of residuals - normal

AM_hyph_pH_lme <- lmer(AM_hyph_per ~ pH + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit)
summary(AM_hyph_pH_lme) #random accounts for less
model_performance(AM_hyph_pH_lme) #AICc -10, BIC -4.4, R2 0.29
cor.test(SOM_13C_T0$AM_hyph_per, SOM_13C_T0$pH, method = "pearson") #0.58

#arb percent
shapiro.test(resid(lmer(AM_arb_per ~ pH + (1|Site_ID), #site random
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit))) #check normality of residuals - not normal but high W
leveneTest(lm(AM_arb_per ~ pH_range, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #homogeneous

AM_arb_pH_lme <- lmer(AM_arb_per ~ pH + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit)
summary(AM_arb_pH_lme) #random accounts for less
model_performance(AM_arb_pH_lme) #AICc -49, BIC -43, R2 0.089
cor.test(SOM_13C_T0$AM_arb_per, SOM_13C_T0$pH, method = "pearson") #0.41


#arb count
shapiro.test(resid(lmer(AM_arb_ct ~ pH + (1|Site_ID), #site random
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit))) #check normality of residuals - not normal but high W
leveneTest(lm(AM_arb_ct ~ pH_range, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #homogeneous

AM_arbct_pH_lme <- lmer(AM_arb_ct ~ pH + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit)
summary(AM_arbct_pH_lme) #random accounts for less
model_performance(AM_arbct_pH_lme) #AICc 226, BIC 231, R2 0.003

```

# Plant Communities

```{r plant groups}

#order variables
plant_harvest$functional_group <- factor(plant_harvest$functional_group, 
                                        levels = c("grass", "forb", "legume", "shrub"))

#plot plant communities
plant_harvest %>%
  filter(functional_group != "moss") %>% #remove mosses
  filter(functional_group != "unknown") %>% #remove unknown
ggplot(aes(x=site_id, y=shoot, fill=functional_group)) + 
	geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_jitter(position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width=0.2, dodge.width=0.75), #add points with jitter
              alpha=0.5, size=0.8, color="black") + #point appearance
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors4) + #define colors to use
  #scale_color_manual(values = colors4) + #define colors to use
  my_theme +
  #ggtitle("Plant Shoot Biomass Across Sites") + #add a graph title
  xlab("") + ylab("Shoot Biomass (g)") #define/change X and Y labels

#save figure
ggsave('plant_groups.svg', #save plot name and type - can be "eps", "pdf", "jpeg", "tiff", "png", "bmp", "svg"
       path = "Figures", #save to folder
       width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", #set dimensions
       dpi = 300, #set resolution
       bg=NULL) #background from plot specifications

shapiro.test(resid(lm(shoot ~ functional_group * site_id, data = plant_harvest[ #check normality of residuals - not normal
                          !is.na(plant_harvest$shoot), c(2,6,7)]))) #subset only columns of interest, remove na
shapiro.test(resid(lm(log(shoot) ~ functional_group * site_id, data = plant_harvest[ #normal
                          !is.na(plant_harvest$shoot), c(2,6,7)]))) #subset only columns of interest, remove na
summary(aov(log(shoot) ~ functional_group * site_id, data = plant_harvest[ 
                          !is.na(plant_harvest$shoot), c(2,6,7)])) #sig for all terms
TukeyHSD(aov(log(shoot) ~ functional_group * site_id, data = plant_harvest[ #normal
                          !is.na(plant_harvest$shoot), c(2,6,7)])) 
#grass:Bickershaw 2-forb:Bickershaw 1       0.0051386
#legume:Amberswood-grass:Bickershaw 2       0.0241997


```

# Microbial Communities

## Alpha diversity
Diversity of species within sites

### 16S
```{r 16S alpha sobs}

#stats
shapiro.test(resid(lm(sobs ~ Site_ID, data = env_16S))) #check normality of residuals - normal
leveneTest(lm(sobs ~ Site_ID, data = env_16S)) #homogeneity of variance - yes
summary(aov(sobs ~ Site_ID, data = env_16S)) #not sig

#plot
ggplot(env_16S, aes(x=Site_ID, y=sobs, fill=Site_ID)) +
  geom_boxplot(coef=Inf) +
  #geom_jitter(shape=16, position=position_jitter(0.1), size = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors4) + #define colors to use
  xlab("") + ylab("16S ASV Richness") + 
  my_theme

ggsave('16S_asv_sobs.svg', #save plot name and type - can be "eps", "pdf", "jpeg", "tiff", "png", "bmp", "svg"
       path = "Figures", #save to folder
       width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", #set dimensions
       dpi = 300, #set resolution
       bg=NULL) #background from plot specifications

```

### ITS 

#### ASVs
```{r ITS alpha sobs}

#stats
shapiro.test(resid(lm(sobs ~ Site_ID, data = env_ITS))) #check normality of residuals - not normal but high W
leveneTest(lm(sobs ~ Site_ID, data = env_ITS)) #homogeneity of variance - no
kruskal.test(sobs ~ Site_ID, data = env_ITS) #almost but not
dunn.test(env_ITS$sobs, env_ITS$Site_ID, kw = TRUE, method = "bonferroni") #not sig

#plot
ggplot(env_ITS, aes(x=Site_ID, y=sobs, fill=Site_ID)) +
  geom_boxplot(coef=Inf) +
  #geom_jitter(shape=16, position=position_jitter(0.1), size = 0.85) +
```

```{r 16S rarefaction curve asv, warning=FALSE}
#ASV counts per site - rarefaction
x16s_rare.out <- rarecurve(asv_16S, step = 10, tidy = TRUE)
x16s_rare.out$Site <- as.factor(x16s_rare.out$Site)
x16s_rare.out$sample.label <- as.factor(x16s_rare.out$Sample)
x16s_rare.out$label <- NA

for (i in unique(x16s_rare.out$Site)) {
  tmp <- x16s_rare.out[which(x16s_rare.out$Site==i),]
  x16s_rare.out$label[which(x16s_rare.out$Sample==max(tmp$Sample)&x16s_rare.out$Site==i)] <- i
}

#plot rarefaction curve
ggplot(data = x16s_rare.out, aes(x = Sample, y = Species, group = Site)) +
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  #geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Number of reads", y = "16S ASVs", title = "Rarefaction curve") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),legend.position = 0) +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Site") +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = label),
                   nudge_x = 1,
                   na.rm = TRUE) + 
  my_theme

ggsave('16S_rarecurve.svg', #save plot name and type - can be "eps", "pdf", "jpeg", "tiff", "png", "bmp", "svg"
```

```{r 16S beta asv, warning=FALSE}

#add coal
env_16S <- env_16S %>%
  merge(per_coal23, by="Plot_ID", all.x = TRUE) 

#calculate distances

#Euclidean distance
x16s_euc.list <-  replicate(100, matrix(nrow = dim(asv_16S)[1], ncol = dim(asv_16S)[1]), simplify = FALSE)
for (i in 1:100) {
  x16s_euc.list[[i]] <- vegdist(sqrt(as.matrix(rrarefy(asv_16S,sample=170))/170), method="euc")
}
asv_16S.ml.euc <- Reduce("+", x16s_euc.list) / length(x16s_euc.list)

#Jaqcard distance
x16s_jaq.list <-  replicate(100, matrix(nrow = dim(asv_16S)[1], ncol = dim(asv_16S)[1]), simplify = FALSE)
for (i in 1:100) {
  x16s_jaq.list[[i]] <- vegdist(as.matrix(rrarefy(asv_16S,sample=170)), method="jaccard", binary = TRUE)
}
asv_16S.jaq <- Reduce("+", x16s_jaq.list) / length(x16s_jaq.list)

#Bray-Curtis
x16s_bray.list <-  replicate(100, matrix(nrow = dim(asv_16S)[1], ncol = dim(asv_16S)[1]), simplify = FALSE)
for (i in 1:100) {
  x16s_bray.list[[i]] <- vegdist(as.matrix(rrarefy(asv_16S,sample=170))/170, method="bray")
}
asv_16S.ml.bray <- Reduce("+", x16s_bray.list) / length(x16s_bray.list)


#PERMANOVA - site
adonis2(asv_16S.ml.euc ~ Site_ID, method = "none", data = env_16S, permutations = 9999) #P=0.032
adonis2(asv_16S.jaq ~ Site_ID, method = "none", data = env_16S, permutations = 9999) #P=0.22
adonis2(asv_16S.ml.bray ~ Site_ID, method = "none", data = env_16S, permutations = 9999) #P=0.026

#PERMANOVA - pH

adonis2(asv_16S.ml.bray ~ pH, method = "none", data = env_16S, permutations = 9999) #P=0.37

#PERMANOVA - plants

adonis2(asv_16S.jaq ~ plant_r, method = "none", data = env_16S, permutations = 9999) #n
adonis2(asv_16S.ml.bray ~ plant_r, method = "none", data = env_16S, permutations = 9999) #n

adonis2(asv_16S.jaq ~ plant_shannon, method = "none", data = env_16S, permutations = 9999) #n
```

##### NMDS

```{r 16S NMDS asv, warning=FALSE}

#Hellinger (square root) transform and standardize with vegan library
asv_16S_h_std <- asv_16S %>%
  dplyr::select((where(is.numeric))) %>% #select only numeric columns
  decostand(., #call decostand transformation function
				 method = "hellinger", #transformation method
				 zap = FALSE, #make near zero values into zeros to avoid exaggeration
				 na.rm = TRUE) %>% #remove NA values
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~scale(., center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)))

x16s_nmds_df <- asv_16S_h_std

#test how many axes are appropriate
stress <- vector(length = 6)
for (i in 1:6) {
    stress[i] <- metaMDS(x16s_nmds_df, distance = "bray", k = i,
                         model = "global", #calc stress on ranks of data
                         maxit = 400, #max iterations of configuration adjustments
                         try = 20, trymax = 20, #min and max runs
                         autotransform = FALSE, #don't transform data
                         weakties = TRUE, #set fitted distances as un-fixed
                         scaling = TRUE, #re-scale ordination axes
                         na.rm = TRUE)$stress
}
names(stress) <- paste0(1:6, "Dim")
par(mar = c(3.5,3.5,1,1), mgp = c(2, 0.6, 0), cex = 0.8, las = 2)
barplot(stress, ylab = "stress")

#run NMDS with 3 axes to be reliably stress < 0.2
set.seed(42) #set seed for reproducibility
x16s_nmds <- metaMDS(x16s_nmds_df, 
                distance = "bray", #data & distance measure
                k = 3, #number of axes
                model = "global", #calc stress on ranks of data
                maxit = 500, #max iterations of configuration adjustments
                try = 20, trymax = 50, #min and max runs
                autotransform = FALSE, #don't transform data
                weakties = TRUE, #set fitted distances as un-fixed
                pc = TRUE, #rotate axes using PCA to orient first 2 axes as containing most of the variability
                scaling = TRUE, #re-scale ordination axes to ‘unit root mean squares’
                na.rm = TRUE) #remove NA values

x16s_nmds #check "stress" value to see how well the data is represented by the ordination
goodness(x16s_nmds) #check goodness of fit for each point
stressplot(x16s_nmds, main = "Shepard plot") #diagnostic plot

#make fit vectors with env variables minus microbial diversity and incomplete columns, view

x16s_nmdsfit <- envfit(x16s_nmds, env_16S[,-c(1:5,17:30)],
                      permutations = 999, na.rm=TRUE)
x16s_nmdsfit #check fit vectors

#standardize env variables - should be same
#env_16S_std <- env_16S[,-c(17:30)] %>% #env file 
 # mutate_if(is.numeric,scale) 
#x16s_nmdsfit <- envfit(x16s_nmds, env_16S_std[,-c(1:4)], #with standardization
 #                     permutations = 999, na.rm=TRUE)
#x16s_nmdsfit #check fit vectors

#make df of scores, add sites
x16s_nmds_scores <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(x16s_nmds))
x16s_nmds_scores$Site_ID = env_16S$Site_ID 

#make df of vectors, only significant vectors
x16s_nmds_vectors <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(x16s_nmdsfit, display = "vectors")) #extracts relevant scores from envfit
x16s_nmds_vectors <- cbind(x16s_nmds_vectors, variable = rownames(x16s_nmds_vectors)) #and then gives them their names
x16s_nmds_vectors <- cbind(x16s_nmds_vectors, pval = x16s_nmdsfit$vectors$pvals) # add pvalues to dataframe
x16s_sig_vectors <- subset(x16s_nmds_vectors, pval<=0.05) #subset data to show variables significant at 0.05

#plot scores with ggplot
ggplot(x16s_nmds_scores) + 
  geom_point(size = 2, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = Site_ID)) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = Site_ID, fill = Site_ID),
               alpha = 0.2, #transparency of ellipse fill
               geom = "polygon") + #draw as polygon rather than just outline
  geom_segment(data = x16s_sig_vectors,
              aes(x = 0, xend = NMDS1 * 400,
                  y = 0, yend = NMDS2 * 400), 
              arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25,"cm"),
                            type = "open", angle = 20,
                            ends = "last"),
              color = "grey10", 
              lwd = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = x16s_sig_vectors,
                  aes(x = NMDS1 * 400,
                      y = NMDS2 * 400, 
                      label = variable), 
                  size = 3,
                  max.overlaps = Inf) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors4) + #match fill colors to your color scheme
  labs(x = "NMDS1", y = "NMDS2", color = "Site", fill = "Site") +
  coord_fixed() +
  my_theme

#save figure - name, type, folder, dimensions, resolution, background specs
ggsave('16S_asv_NMDS_130826.svg', path = "Figures", width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 300, bg=NULL)
```

```{r 16S beta sp, warning=FALSE}
asv_16S.ml.euc.s <- Reduce("+", x16s_euc.list.s) / length(x16s_euc.list.s)

#Jaqcard distance
x16s_jaq.list.s <-  replicate(100, matrix(nrow = dim(asv_16S.s)[1], ncol = dim(asv_16S.s)[1]), simplify = FALSE)
for (i in 1:100) {
  x16s_jaq.list.s[[i]] <- vegdist(as.matrix(rrarefy(asv_16S.s,sample=170)), method="jaccard", binary = TRUE)
}
asv_16S.jaq.s <- Reduce("+", x16s_jaq.list.s) / length(x16s_jaq.list.s)

#Bray-Curtis
x16s_bray.list.s <-  replicate(100, matrix(nrow = dim(asv_16S.s)[1], ncol = dim(asv_16S.s)[1]), simplify = FALSE)
```

##### NMDS

```{r 16S NMDS sp, warning=FALSE}

#Hellinger (square root) transform and standardize with vegan library
asv_16S_s_h_std <- asv_16S.s %>%
  dplyr::select((where(is.numeric))) %>% #select only numeric columns
  decostand(., #call decostand transformation function
				 method = "hellinger", #transformation method
				 zap = FALSE, #make near zero values into zeros to avoid exaggeration
				 na.rm = TRUE) %>% #remove NA values
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~scale(., center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)))

x16s_nmds_df <- asv_16S_s_h_std

#test how many axes are appropriate
stress <- vector(length = 6)
for (i in 1:6) {
    stress[i] <- metaMDS(x16s_nmds_df, distance = "bray", k = i,
                         model = "global", #calc stress on ranks of data
                         maxit = 400, #max iterations of configuration adjustments
                         try = 20, trymax = 20, #min and max runs
                         autotransform = FALSE, #don't transform data
                         weakties = TRUE, #set fitted distances as un-fixed
                         scaling = TRUE, #re-scale ordination axes
                         na.rm = TRUE)$stress
}
names(stress) <- paste0(1:6, "Dim")
par(mar = c(3.5,3.5,1,1), mgp = c(2, 0.6, 0), cex = 0.8, las = 2)
barplot(stress, ylab = "stress")

#run NMDS with 5 axes to be reliably stress < 0.2
set.seed(42) #set seed for reproducibility
x16s_nmds <- metaMDS(x16s_nmds_df, 
                distance = "bray", #data & distance measure
                k = 3, #number of axes
                model = "global", #calc stress on ranks of data
                maxit = 400, #max iterations of configuration adjustments
                try = 20, trymax = 200, #min and max runs
                autotransform = FALSE, #don't transform data
                weakties = TRUE, #set fitted distances as un-fixed
                pc = TRUE, #rotate axes using PCA to orient first 2 axes as containing most of the variability
                scaling = TRUE, #re-scale ordination axes to ‘unit root mean squares’
                na.rm = TRUE) #remove NA values

x16s_nmds #check "stress" value to see how well the data is represented by the ordination
goodness(x16s_nmds) #check goodness of fit for each point
stressplot(x16s_nmds, main = "Shepard plot") #diagnostic plot

#make fit vectors with env variables and view
x16s_nmdsfit <- envfit(x16s_nmds, env_16S_std[,-c(1:4)], #with standardization
                      permutations = 999, na.rm=TRUE)
x16s_nmdsfit #check fit vectors

#make df of scores, add sites
x16s_nmds_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(x16s_nmds))
x16s_nmds_scores$Site_ID = env_16S$Site_ID 

#make df of vectors, only significant vectors
x16s_nmds_vectors <- as.data.frame(scores(x16s_nmdsfit, display = "vectors")) #extracts relevant scores from envfit
x16s_nmds_vectors <- cbind(x16s_nmds_vectors, variable = rownames(x16s_nmds_vectors)) #and then gives them their names
x16s_nmds_vectors <- cbind(x16s_nmds_vectors, pval = x16s_nmdsfit$vectors$pvals) # add pvalues to dataframe
x16s_sig_vectors <- subset(x16s_nmds_vectors, pval<=0.1) #subset data to show variables somewhat significant at rounded 0.1

#plot scores with ggplot
ggplot(x16s_nmds_scores) + 
  geom_point(size = 2, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = Site_ID)) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = Site_ID, fill = Site_ID),
               alpha = 0.2, #transparency of ellipse fill
               geom = "polygon") + #draw as polygon rather than just outline
  geom_segment(data = x16s_sig_vectors,
              aes(x = 0, xend = NMDS1 * 400,
                  y = 0, yend = NMDS2 * 400), 
              arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25,"cm"),
                            type = "open", angle = 20,
                            ends = "last"),
              color = "grey10", 
              lwd = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = x16s_sig_vectors,
                  aes(x = NMDS1 * 400,
                      y = NMDS2 * 400, 
                      label = variable), 
                  size = 3,
                  max.overlaps = Inf) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors4) + #match fill colors to your color scheme
  labs(x = "NMDS1", y = "NMDS2", color = "Site", fill = "Site") +
  coord_fixed() +
  my_theme

#save figure - name, type, folder, dimensions, resolution, background specs
ggsave('16S_sp_NMDS_210526.svg', path = "Figures", width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 300, bg=NULL)

```

```{r ITS rarefaction curve asv, warning=FALSE}
#ASV counts per site - rarefaction
its_rare.out <- rarecurve(asv_ITS, step = 10, tidy = TRUE)
its_rare.out$Site <- as.factor(its_rare.out$Site)
its_rare.out$sample.label <- as.factor(its_rare.out$Sample)
its_rare.out$label <- NA

for (i in unique(its_rare.out$Site)) {
  tmp <- its_rare.out[which(its_rare.out$Site==i),]
  its_rare.out$label[which(its_rare.out$Sample==max(tmp$Sample)&its_rare.out$Site==i)] <- i
}

#plot rarefaction curve
ggplot(data = its_rare.out, aes(x = Sample, y = Species, group = Site)) +
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  #geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Number of reads", y = "ITS ASVs", title = "Rarefaction curve") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),legend.position = 0) +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Site") +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = label),
                   nudge_x = 1,
                   na.rm = TRUE) + 
  my_theme
```

```{r ITS beta asv, warning=FALSE}

#add coal
env_ITS <- env_ITS %>%
  merge(per_coal23, by="Plot_ID", all.x = TRUE) 

#calculate distances

#Euclidean distance
its_euc.list <-  replicate(100, matrix(nrow = dim(asv_ITS)[1], ncol = dim(asv_ITS)[1]), simplify = FALSE)
for (i in 1:100) {
  its_euc.list[[i]] <- vegdist(sqrt(as.matrix(rrarefy(asv_ITS,sample=170))/170), method="euc")
}
asv_ITS.ml.euc <- Reduce("+", its_euc.list) / length(its_euc.list)

#Jaqcard distance
its_jaq.list <-  replicate(100, matrix(nrow = dim(asv_ITS)[1], ncol = dim(asv_ITS)[1]), simplify = FALSE)
for (i in 1:100) {
  its_jaq.list[[i]] <- vegdist(as.matrix(rrarefy(asv_ITS,sample=170)), method="jaccard", binary = TRUE)
}
asv_ITS.jaq <- Reduce("+", its_jaq.list) / length(its_jaq.list)

#Bray-Curtis
its_bray.list <-  replicate(100, matrix(nrow = dim(asv_ITS)[1], ncol = dim(asv_ITS)[1]), simplify = FALSE)
for (i in 1:100) {
  its_bray.list[[i]] <- vegdist(as.matrix(rrarefy(asv_ITS,sample=170))/170, method="bray")
}
asv_ITS.ml.bray <- Reduce("+", its_bray.list) / length(its_bray.list)
```

```{r ITS NMDS asv, warning=FALSE}
#make fit vectors with env variables minus fungal biomass and diversity and coal columns, view 
its_nmdsfit <- envfit(its_nmds, env_ITS[,-c(1:4,17:32)], #without standardization
                      permutations = 9999, na.rm=TRUE)
its_nmdsfit #check fit vectors

#standardize env variables - should be same
env_ITS_std <- env_ITS[,-c(17:32)] %>% #env file 
  #na.omit() %>% #only complete cases
  mutate_if(is.numeric,scale) 
its_nmdsfit <- envfit(its_nmds, env_ITS_std[,-c(1:4)], #with standardization - should be same
                      permutations = 9999, na.rm=TRUE)
its_nmdsfit #check fit vectors

#make df of scores, add sites
its_nmds_scores <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(its_nmds))
its_nmds_scores$Site_ID = env_ITS$Site_ID 

#make df of vectors, only significant vectors
its_nmds_vectors <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(its_nmdsfit, display = "vectors")) #extracts relevant scores from envfit
its_nmds_vectors <- cbind(its_nmds_vectors, variable = rownames(its_nmds_vectors)) #and then gives them their names
its_nmds_vectors <- cbind(its_nmds_vectors, pval = its_nmdsfit$vectors$pvals) # add pvalues to dataframe
its_sig_vectors <- subset(its_nmds_vectors, pval<=0.05) #subset data to show variables significant at 0.05

#plot scores with ggplot
ggplot(its_nmds_scores) + 
  geom_point(size = 2, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = Site_ID)) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = Site_ID, fill = Site_ID),
               alpha = 0.2, #transparency of ellipse fill
               geom = "polygon") + #draw as polygon rather than just outline
  geom_segment(data = its_sig_vectors,
              aes(x = 0, xend = NMDS1 * 400,
                  y = 0, yend = NMDS2 * 400), 
              arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25,"cm"),
                            type = "open", angle = 20,
                            ends = "last"),
              color = "grey10", 
              lwd = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = its_sig_vectors,
                  aes(x = NMDS1 * 400,
                      y = NMDS2 * 400, 
                      label = variable), 
                  size = 3,
                  max.overlaps = Inf) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors4) + #match fill colors to your color scheme
  labs(x = "NMDS1", y = "NMDS2", color = "Site", fill = "Site") +
  coord_fixed() +
  my_theme

#save figure - name, type, folder, dimensions, resolution, background specs
ggsave('ITS_asv_NMDS_050826.svg', path = "Figures", width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 300, bg=NULL)
```

##### NMDS

```{r ITS NMDS sp, warning=FALSE}

#Hellinger (square root) transform and standardize with vegan library
asv_ITS_s_h_std <- asv_ITS.s %>%
  dplyr::select((where(is.numeric))) %>% #select only numeric columns
  decostand(., #call decostand transformation function
				 method = "hellinger", #transformation method
				 zap = FALSE, #make near zero values into zeros to avoid exaggeration
				 na.rm = TRUE) %>% #remove NA values
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~scale(., center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)))

its_nmds_df <- asv_ITS_s_h_std

#test how many axes are appropriate
stress <- vector(length = 6)
for (i in 1:6) {
    stress[i] <- metaMDS(its_nmds_df, distance = "bray", k = i,
                         model = "global", #calc stress on ranks of data
                         maxit = 400, #max iterations of configuration adjustments
                         try = 20, trymax = 20, #min and max runs
                         autotransform = FALSE, #don't transform data
                         weakties = TRUE, #set fitted distances as un-fixed
                         scaling = TRUE, #re-scale ordination axes
                         na.rm = TRUE)$stress
}
names(stress) <- paste0(1:6, "Dim")
par(mar = c(3.5,3.5,1,1), mgp = c(2, 0.6, 0), cex = 0.8, las = 2)
barplot(stress, ylab = "stress")

#run NMDS with 5 axes to be reliably stress < 0.2
set.seed(42) #set seed for reproducibility
its_nmds <- metaMDS(its_nmds_df, 
                distance = "bray", #data & distance measure
                k = 3, #number of axes
                model = "global", #calc stress on ranks of data
                maxit = 400, #max iterations of configuration adjustments
                try = 20, trymax = 200, #min and max runs
                autotransform = FALSE, #don't transform data
                weakties = TRUE, #set fitted distances as un-fixed
                pc = TRUE, #rotate axes using PCA to orient first 2 axes as containing most of the variability
                scaling = TRUE, #re-scale ordination axes to ‘unit root mean squares’
                na.rm = TRUE) #remove NA values

its_nmds #check "stress" value to see how well the data is represented by the ordination
goodness(its_nmds) #check goodness of fit for each point
stressplot(its_nmds, main = "Shepard plot") #diagnostic plot

#make fit vectors with env variables and view
#its_nmdsfit <- envfit(its_nmds, env_ITS[,-c(1:4,17:30)], #without standardization
 #                     permutations = 999, na.rm=TRUE)
its_nmdsfit <- envfit(its_nmds, env_ITS_std[,-c(1:4)], #with standardization
                      permutations = 999, na.rm=TRUE)
its_nmdsfit #check fit vectors

#make df of scores, add sites
its_nmds_scores <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(its_nmds))
its_nmds_scores$Site_ID = env_ITS$Site_ID 

#make df of vectors, only significant vectors
its_nmds_vectors <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(its_nmdsfit, display = "vectors")) #extracts relevant scores from envfit
its_nmds_vectors <- cbind(its_nmds_vectors, variable = rownames(its_nmds_vectors)) #and then gives them their names
its_nmds_vectors <- cbind(its_nmds_vectors, pval = its_nmdsfit$vectors$pvals) # add pvalues to dataframe
its_sig_vectors <- subset(its_nmds_vectors, pval<=0.1) #subset data to show variables somewhat significant at rounded 0.1

#plot scores with ggplot
ggplot(its_nmds_scores) + 
  geom_point(size = 2, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = Site_ID)) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = Site_ID, fill = Site_ID),
               alpha = 0.2, #transparency of ellipse fill
               geom = "polygon") + #draw as polygon rather than just outline
  geom_segment(data = its_sig_vectors,
              aes(x = 0, xend = NMDS1 * 400,
                  y = 0, yend = NMDS2 * 400), 
              arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25,"cm"),
                            type = "open", angle = 20,
                            ends = "last"),
              color = "grey10", 
              lwd = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = its_sig_vectors,
                  aes(x = NMDS1 * 400,
                      y = NMDS2 * 400, 
                      label = variable), 
                  size = 3,
                  max.overlaps = Inf) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors4) + #match fill colors to your color scheme
  labs(x = "NMDS1", y = "NMDS2", color = "Site", fill = "Site") +
  coord_fixed() +
  my_theme

#save figure - name, type, folder, dimensions, resolution, background specs
ggsave('ITS_sp_NMDS_050826.svg', path = "Figures", width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 300, bg=NULL)
```

```{r recovery}

SOM_13C_T0 %>%
ggplot(aes(x=Site_ID, y=recovery, fill=Site_ID)) + 
	geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values=colors4) + #define colors to use
  #scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Bickershaw U", "Bickershaw M", "Amberswood M", "Flashes M")) + #change x axis labels
  #ggtitle("Rocks and Debris per site") + #add a graph title
  xlab("") + ylab(expression(""^13*"C Recovery (%)")) + #define/change X and Y labels
  my_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

#save figure

	path = "Figures", #save to folder within working directory
	width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", #set dimensions for figure
	dpi = 300, #set resolution
	bg=NULL) #background from plot specifications

#diagnostics
shapiro.test(resid(lm(recovery ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C_T0))) #normal
leveneTest(lm(recovery ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #homogenous

#ANOVA 
summary(aov(recovery ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #not sig

#try other factors
summary(aov(recovery ~ AM_hyph_per, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #not sig
summary(aov(recovery ~ plant_r, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #not sig
summary(aov(recovery ~ plant_shannon, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #not sig
summary(aov(recovery ~ plant_simpson, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #not sig
summary(aov(recovery ~ plant_biomass, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #not sig
summary(aov(recovery ~ shoot_mass, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #sig!
summary(aov(recovery ~ root_mass, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #not sig
summary(aov(recovery ~ pH, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #not sig
summary(aov(recovery ~ SOM_N, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #sig!
summary(aov(recovery ~ SOM_CN, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #sig!

shapiro.test(resid(lm(recovery ~ shoot_mass, data = SOM_13C_T0))) #normal
Anova(lmer(recovery ~ shoot_mass + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit), type = 3) #very
rcvy_shoot_lme <- lmer(recovery ~ shoot_mass + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit)
summary(rcvy_shoot_lme) #random accounts for less
model_performance(rcvy_shoot_lme) #AICc, BIC, R2
cor.test(SOM_13C_T0$recovery, SOM_13C_T0$shoot_mass, method = "pearson") #0.75

shapiro.test(resid(lm(recovery ~ SOM_N, data = SOM_13C_T0))) #normal
Anova(lmer(recovery ~ SOM_N + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit), type = 3)
rcvy_N_lme <- lmer(recovery ~ SOM_N + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit)
summary(rcvy_N_lme) #random accounts for less
model_performance(rcvy_N_lme) #AICc, BIC, R2
cor.test(SOM_13C_T0$recovery, SOM_13C_T0$SOM_N, method = "pearson") #0.56

shapiro.test(resid(lm(recovery ~ SOM_CN, data = SOM_13C_T0))) #not normal
shapiro.test(resid(lm(log(recovery) ~ SOM_CN, data = SOM_13C_T0))) #normal
Anova(lmer(log(recovery) ~ SOM_CN + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit), type = 3)
rcvy_CN_lme <- lmer(log(recovery) ~ SOM_CN + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = SOM_13C_T0, #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit)
summary(rcvy_CN_lme) #random accounts for less
model_performance(rcvy_CN_lme) #AICc, BIC, R2 
cor.test(SOM_13C_T0$recovery, SOM_13C_T0$SOM_CN, method = "pearson") #0.56
```

## Soil isotopes

### Pre-Label and Time 0

#### Soil 13C


```{r soil 13C}

#test differences in pre-label soils (natural abundance) 13C
shapiro.test(resid(lm(d13C ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C[c(1:39),]))) #check normality of residuals - normal
leveneTest(lm(d13C ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C[c(1:39),])) #homogeneity
summary(aov(d13C ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C[c(1:39),])) #sig
TukeyHSD(aov(d13C ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C[c(1:39),])) #Flashes > Ambers

shapiro.test(resid(lm(`13C_atom` ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C[c(1:39),]))) #check normality of residuals - normal
leveneTest(lm(`13C_atom` ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C[c(1:39),])) #homogeneity
summary(aov(`13C_atom` ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C[c(1:39),])) #sig
TukeyHSD(aov(`13C_atom` ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C[c(1:39),])) #Flashes > Ambers

#test differences in post-label soils 13C
shapiro.test(resid(lm(SOM_d13C ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C_T0))) #check normality of residuals - not normal, but high W
leveneTest(lm(SOM_d13C ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #homogeneity
summary(aov(SOM_d13C ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #not sig
kruskal.test(SOM_d13C ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C_T0) #not sig

#test differences in excess 13C in pots at T0
shapiro.test(resid(lm(SOM_pot13C_mg ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C_T0))) #check normality of residuals - not normal, but high W
leveneTest(lm(SOM_pot13C_mg ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #homogeneity
summary(aov(SOM_pot13C_mg ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #sig
kruskal.test(SOM_pot13C_mg ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C_T0) #sig
TukeyHSD(aov(SOM_pot13C_mg ~ Site_ID, data = SOM_13C_T0)) #FM > BU & AM, BM almost > BU
dunn.test(SOM_13C_T0$SOM_pot13C_mg, SOM_13C_T0$Site_ID, kw = TRUE, method = "bonferroni") #FM > BU & AM
```

```{r soil 13C T0 plot}
                color = "grey10", width = 0.7, position = "dodge") +

  theme(legend.position = "none")

	dpi = 300, #set resolution
	bg=NULL) #background from plot specifications
```

```{r decomp stats}

endbiomass$decomp_per_adj <- as.numeric(endbiomass$decomp_per_adj)

#ANOVA and Tukey - Site comparison
shapiro.test(resid(lm(decomp_per_adj ~ Site_ID, data = endbiomass[-1,]))) #normal
leveneTest(lm(decomp_per_adj ~ Site_ID, data = endbiomass[-1,])) #homogenous
summary(aov(decomp_per_adj ~ factor(Site_ID), data = endbiomass[-1,])) #sig
TukeyHSD(aov(decomp_per_adj ~ factor(Site_ID), data = endbiomass[-1,])) #FM > BU, BM, AM > BU

#AM association
shapiro.test(resid(lm(decomp_per_adj ~ AM_hyph_per + AM_arb_per + AM_ves_ct, data = endbiomass[-1,]))) #check normality of residuals - normal
summary(aov(decomp_per_adj ~ AM_hyph_per + AM_arb_per + AM_ves_ct, data = endbiomass[-1,])) #hyph almost

#pH
shapiro.test(resid(lm(decomp_per_adj ~ pH, data = endbiomass[-1,]))) #check normality of residuals - normal
summary(aov(decomp_per_adj ~ pH, data = endbiomass[-1,])) #very sig

Anova(lmer(decomp_per_adj ~ pH + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = endbiomass[-1,], #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit), type=3) #pH

decomp_pH_lme <- lmer(decomp_per_adj ~ pH + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = endbiomass[-1,], #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit)
summary(decomp_pH_lme) #random accounts for less variance
shapiro.test(resid(decomp_pH_lme)) #not normal, log was worse
model_performance(decomp_pH_lme)

#decomp versus coal waste
shapiro.test(resid(lm(decomp_per_adj ~ rocks_debris, data = endbiomass[-1,]))) #check normality of residuals - normal
summary(aov(decomp_per_adj ~ rocks_debris, data = endbiomass[-1,])) #very sig

Anova(lmer(decomp_per_adj ~ rocks_debris + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = endbiomass[-1,], #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit), type=3) #debris

decomp_debris_lme <- lmer(decomp_per_adj ~ rocks_debris + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = endbiomass[-1,], #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit)
summary(decomp_debris_lme) #random accounts for less variance
shapiro.test(resid(decomp_debris_lme)) #normal
model_performance(decomp_debris_lme)

#decomp versus coal waste and pH
shapiro.test(resid(lm(decomp_per_adj ~ rocks_debris + pH, data = endbiomass[-1,]))) #normal
summary(aov(decomp_per_adj ~ rocks_debris + pH, data = endbiomass[-1,])) #debris only very sig
Anova(lmer(decomp_per_adj ~ rocks_debris + pH + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = endbiomass[-1,], #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit), type=3) #neither quite

#decomp versus worms
shapiro.test(resid(lm(decomp_per_adj ~ worms, data = endbiomass[-1,]))) #check normality of residuals - normal
summary(aov(decomp_per_adj ~ worms, data = endbiomass[-1,])) #not sig

```
